evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports that QwQ-32B was assessed on benchmarks covering mathematical reasoning, coding proficiency, and general problem-solving, and that the model is openly available under the Apache 2.0 license on Hugging Face and ModelScope as well as through Qwen Chat.

identity.name: QwQ-32B
identity.summary: QwQ-32B is a 32-billion-parameter reasoning model from the Qwen series.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: 32B causal language model reported only on math/coding/problem-solving benchmarks, with no mention of factuality or grounding evaluation, so it plausibly produces factually inaccurate text.

specifications.model_size: 61.0 GiB of safetensors weights (65,527,841,688 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model underwent pretraining followed by post-training that included supervised finetuning and reinforcement learning.
